programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Lying in the culinary heart of Vienna like an island, a little world of treats rises in the midst: the Naschmarkt food market. A throng of buyers and curious onlookers meander through the stalls all consumed by the scent of spices, distracted by the smell of sausage, and stunned by the diversity of turnips, tubers, foliage, and fruit on display. The Naschmarkt truly is Vienna's most popular belly.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Vienna

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The market of San Benedetto in Cagliari is the island's belly. It is one of the biggest fresh produce markets in Europe and arguably said to be the biggest fish market in Europe. A paradise for food lovers, where every stall keeper has a story to tell.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cagliari

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's show is a special celebration of Julie's favorite season, Spring! This refreshing time of year puts a smile on Julie's face focusing her cooking on springtime offerings. What better way for Julie to cook, create and celebrate this sensational season than with her crown roasted leg of lamb infused with a bouquet of fresh herbs, slowly roasted, makes the centerpiece on the springtime table!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Spring Sensations

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie makes her Mezze magical in a stunning and scrumptious presentation of her Lebanese cultures most famous small plates perfectly plated for her loving Lebanese family to savor! Mezze, internationally known all over the world as one of the most distinctive and delicious display of dishes to discover originating from Lebanon and Middle East. Julie Taboulie's Mezze makes entertaining enchanting.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Magical Mezze Amidst the Moonlight

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's show, a fresh farmer's market is inspiring Julie to make her marvelous Makbouseh, a Lebanese-style summertime squash stew. Julie's Makbouseh, a magnificent medley of fresh vegetables and array of amazing aromatics slowly simmer into a scrumptious squash stew, sure to be a staple at your table. Fresh from the farmer's market to a mouthwatering Lebanese masterpiece you won't want to miss.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Meet Me At The Market

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Join the "Queen of Lebanese Cuisine", Julie Taboulie, as she pays a special tribute to her namesake dish and her culinary traditions. Throughout this visually vibrant show, Julie takes viewers back to memory lane of her Lebanese heritage and authentic dishes she grew up eating ever since she was a young girl at her family's Lebanese table. It's tart, it's tangy, it's tasty. It's Julie's Taboulie!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - It's Taboulie Time

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: In this sensational season opener, Julie finds herself in a garden of dreams in Mama's Glorious Garden. Special Mama and garden serves as Julie's number one source of inspiration, ideas influencing her to cook, create and celebrate her impressive line-up of fresh, flavorful, fabulous Lebanese foods. More garden, more glory, most of all more Mama in Julie's garden of dreams, dig into deliciousness!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Garden of Dreams

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: STOP! And, smell the roses with Julie's rose water signature scented sweets hailing from Lebanon and the Middle East. Beautiful and breathtaking rose gardens inspire Julie's baking. Julie's rose water signature sweets will surely have you stopping to smell the roses, inspiring you to create her sweets for yourself right at home as she simply shows you how step-by-step in true Julie Taboulie style.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Stop & Smell The Roses

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Special seasonal sweets straight from Lebanon and Middle East always signify the holiday season for Julie as she warmly welcomes you into her home for Christmas and the Holiday season. This special show Julie is masterfully making and baking some of the most famous sweets, her personal favorite and most popular requested recipes, Baklawa and Knefeh pastries from Julie's Lebanese kitchen to yours!
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Lebanese Sweets for the Holiday Season

programme.title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen
programme.desc: Julie's falling for Fattoush and you will be too. Her Lebanese peasant-style bread salad is sure to become your new favorite, it's full of flavor and fresh surprises! This spectacular salad is tossed together with Julie's homemade crispy crunchy, toasted-to-perfection pita bread, tossed in Julie's lemony vinaigrette, seasoned with sumac, it's key ingredient, makes this famous salad so satisfying.
programme.sub-title: Julie Taboulie's Lebanese Kitchen - Falling for Fattoush

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: It can be a challenge to put dinner together in a working household. And then what happens when you're working opposite shifts? Ellie helps a frazzled couple trying to get healthy weeknight dinners on the table when conflicting schedules and priorities intervene. Recipes include Shrimp with Spinach, Garlic and Smoked Paprika, Peach Chicken with Crispy Bread Crumbs, and Mango-Coconut Sorbet.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Crazy Schedule Dinner Challenge

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: He's a meat eater. She's a vegetarian. Their kitchen has become a battleground. Can this marriage be saved? It's Ellie to the rescue with flexible recipes that will bring them together. Recipes include Warm Spinach Salad with grilled sirloin, Panzanella with White Beans with chicken sausage, Forbidden Rice Bowl, and Grilled veggies & lamb kabobs served with Tahini Sauce.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Herbivore VS Carnivore

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Ellie prepares an ensemble of make-ahead dishes that are designed so that both party-giver and partygoers can equally enjoy the festivities. These dishes can be cooked and frozen ahead of time and then reheated at party time. Go ahead: enjoy your own party. Recipes include Asian Shrimp Cakes served with Avocado-Wasabi Sauce, Chicken Phyllo Pies, Broccoli & Sun-Dried Tomato Flatbread, and more.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - It's My Party

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.
programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Are you floundering when it comes to adding fish to your menu? Ellie is your fishing guide as she demystifies the choosing, prepping, and cooking of fish. programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - How To Fish

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food
programme.desc: Tired of snoring through your salad? Shake up the same-old same-old with some recipes that awaken all the senses. programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Unboring Salads

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food

Delve into the historic Tatum Cabin, where delightful recipes are prepared, capturing the essence of Boone's heritage.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Flavors of the High Country - Boone, North Carolina

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib travels to the enchanting Pacific island of New Caledonia and discovers the harmonious fusion of French and indigenous Kanaky culture and the mouthwatering cuisine born from this blend. From a centuries-old Bougna recipe to the French pastry shops that dot the capital city, New Caledonia is a culinary treasure.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Paris of the Pacific - New Caledonia

programme.title: A Taste of History

At the historic Harriton house, Chef Staib prepares recipes that pay homage to New York's roots.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Melting Pot Metropolis - New York City

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Embark on a captivating history of Machias, Maine and the first naval battle of the Revolutionary War. Gain insight into the region's sustainable practices and the symbiotic relationship between the land and sea. Inspired by the local bounty, Chef Staib creates mouthwatering recipes that celebrate this remarkable coastal town.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Tides of a Revolution - The Battle of Machias Bay

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Travel to Old Fort Harrod in Harrodsburg, Kentucky to explore the history of the fort and life of James Harrod. Joined by Mary Barlow, Chef Walter Staib pays tribute to the culinary heritage in the George Rogers Clark Cabin, they prepare historic recipes including a Kentucky Elk roast and a delightful Stack Cake, showcasing the traditional flavors of the region.
programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Birthplace of Kentucky - Harrodsburg, Kentucky

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib takes a journey Down Under to Sydney, Australia, where he learns of the regenerative techniques Australian Farmers use to create delicious-tasting Beef and support a sustainable future for the planet. programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Grilling Down Under - New South Wales, Australia

programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - A Multicultural Menu - Victoria, Australia

programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Flavors of the First State - Delaware

programme.title: A Taste of History

programme.sub-title: A Taste of History - Savoring Oaxaca - The Spirit of Mezcal

Fortunately, she meets a crippled woman, who also fell victim to the gang, instructs Kwan how to defeat the gang leaders.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pastrana está en manos de Aurelio, después que Eunice lo entregara a cambio de Ninón. Como cazador a su presa, Casillas y Skinny lo persiguen. A sangre y fuego, la muerte rodea a todos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo y sus aliados del narcotráfico regresan para ser dueños del negocio y acabar con Casillas y todos los integrantes de su familia. Hieren a Ismael y Javier es víctima de un atentado.
programme.sub-title: A la caza de Aurelio Casillas

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ahora que Casillas tocó el corazón de Niñón quiere saber la verdad, si ella mandó a matar a Pilar. Ella insiste en que no lo hizo, pero él no le cree. Rutila se niega a buscar al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Paloma sufre un paro cardíaco y Omar piensa que murió, pero el médico le informa que la pudieron revivir. Cuando ella reacciona y le pregunta por qué la quiso matar, el presidente desata su ira.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Salvio y sus hombres encuentran a Esperanza, Aurelio ordena que la eliminen. Aunque Salvio no quiere atacar, Skinny dice que deberían hacerlo. Empieza el tiroteo. Hay varias bajas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Juan Carlos llega a la casa de Aurelio y él se sorprende. Ismael se entera de que el padre de Esperanza logró dar con ellos. Casillas quiere saber cómo lo hizo. Javi anhela un hijo con Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Juan Carlos le explica a Aurelio cómo llegó hasta él y Casillas trata de saber si le dice la verdad. Salvatierra propone pagar por el rescate de Esperanza. Mientras hablan, secuestran a Pina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio hace un recuento de todos los muertos que lleva en su conciencia. Cree que llegó la hora de deshacerse de alguien más. Por su traición, ahora Mónica teme que Casillas le quite a Isidro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras ser descubierta la casa de seguridad, Aurelio ordena evacuarla. Mónica trata de llevarse a Isidro con ella, pero es detenida por Ninón; ambas discuten. Robles es forzada a dejar al niño.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila llama a Casillas y le pide que tenga piedad con Esperanza, porque ella no tuvo la culpa de que la DEA la capturara. Aurelio es tajante y sella su destino. Un video de Terán lo compromete.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y sus secuaces observan a Tony y Esperanza. Casillas lleva a Pina y a Juan Carlos para el intercambio por su hija e ignora sus súplicas. Castillo y Colón van al punto de la negociación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Salvatierra y Salazar llegan en helicóptero a rescatar a Esperanza, pero algo sale mal. Mónica termina su relación con Pastrana y jura acabar con Ninón, con tal de recuperar a su hijo, Isidro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Javier y Rutila se enteran del plan de los colombianos, de no venderle más coca a los mexicanos y son encerrados por Quezada. Pretenden deshacerse de ellos. Leandro quiere una alianza con Tony.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio viaja a Colombia para intentar rescatar a Rutila. Tony llega y reconoce a Javi. Por otro lado, se acercan la Felina y Raymundo. La casa de Leandro Quezada está rodeada.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pastrana está en manos de Aurelio, después que Eunice lo entregara a cambio de Ninón. Como cazador a su presa, Casillas y Skinny lo persiguen. A sangre y fuego, la muerte rodea a todos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo y sus aliados del narcotráfico regresan para ser dueños del negocio y acabar con Casillas y todos los integrantes de su familia. Hieren a Ismael y Javier es víctima de un atentado.
programme.sub-title: A la caza de Aurelio Casillas

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En cadena nacional, Aurelio Casillas desafía a los narcos de Colombia y deja mal parado al presidente. Se escabulle en medio de un operativo policial. Corina le revela que es de la DEA.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La agente especial de la DEA le asegura a Casillas que no lo vendió y está dispuesta a dar su vida por él; pero Aurelio no le cree. Javi despierta, desmemoriado. Quezada prepara su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Llega la hora de la venganza y Leandro Quezada tiene la oportunidad de deshacerse de El Señor de Los Cielos y de su hija. El Cabo ordena a Jaime conseguirle una cita con el presidente.
programme.sub-title: Atacan a Casillas y a Rutila

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El negocio del narcotráfico se mueve rápido: Casillas coquetea con Maldonado en la selva y el Cabo soborna al jefe del estado mayor de México. Buscan extraditar a Aurelio y al presidente.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Las narcotienditas se quedan sin mercancía y Casillas no tiene cómo conseguirla. El Cabo triunfa en el negocio y jura sacarlo de la jugada. Aurelio hace el amor con Corina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Narcos mexicanos y colombianos luchan por el dominio del territorio y la sangre corre por las calles. Aurelio mata a un policía y el Cabo ordena atropellar al Mocho para evitar que hable.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas recibe la ubicación del Secretario de Seguridad, Castillo, en bandeja de plata, tal como Corina se lo prometió. El Cabo niega la alianza de Quezada. Quiere al pez gordo solo para él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas y sus hombres raptan a Castillo y lo liberan, con la condición de que encarcele al presidente de México. Zuleta chantajea a Terán y logra que acepte la junta con el Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo y el presidente pactan eliminar a Casillas. Terán obtendrá votos y control de los carteles y el Cabo su venganza. Zuleta mintió y queda en evidencia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rumbo a Turquía, Casillas y Ámbar Maldonado van por negocios y desatan el juego de la seducción: el Águila blanca debe sacar el demonio que ella lleva por dentro. Corina está celosa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Quezada y sus hombres matan a sangre fría a los lugartenientes del Cabo y se quedan a cargo de un laboratorio, dejándole claro con quién debe negociar. Casillas y Ámbar pasean, como enamorados.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Con una verdadera demostración de fuerza y dominio de las armas, Casillas y Maldonado huyen de los turcos en el camión de oro venezolano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Para no perjudicar su campaña, el padre de Jaime le pide a Omar que, por favor, se aleje de su hijo. Corina le dice a Aurelio que la muerte de Quezada fue una farsa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas desconfía de Ámbar al leer una nota en la que lo cita en el muelle y se excusa por un asunto urgente. Un turco pasará las tres toneladas de oro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas amenaza a Ámbar con lanzarla del avión, pero ella trae consigo un detonador nuclear. Rutila halla una pista de Javi en la selva. Quezada consigue a su doble para despistar al enemigo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo la llama por el nombre de su abuela, ella descubre que es su abuelo. La esposa lo espera en tierra y para que no lo atrapen con su amante, la lanza de la avioneta en paracaídas.
programme.sub-title: Enamorado de la nieta; Yo te salvé la vida

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Compra la empresa donde sufrió acoso y pone a su exjefe a trabajar como pene gigante. Los duques de Sealand, el país más pequeño del mundo, se enfrentan por títulos nobiliarios y propiedades.
programme.sub-title: Venganza fálica; Los duques de Sealand

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sofía descubre que su marido cumplió prisión por asesinar y descuartizar a su exesposa. En otro caso, Catalina y Walid tienen una joyería, ella decide esconder unos diamantes.
programme.sub-title: Asesino en redes; El patrimonio de mi hijo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sebastián y José son hermanos que pelean por una uva que produce un excelente vino. Una pareja enfrenta un serio problema: la abuela padece una enfermedad que desinhibe los deseos sexuales.
programme.sub-title: El robo de la uva; Pick

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gleiber sufre las consecuencias de las caricaturas mal intencionadas de Jorge. En otro caso, Jenny quiere cumplir el último deseo de su hija de 12 años, antes de que la niña muera de cáncer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María exige que Elena le pague por los daños que su hija, con síndrome de Down, sufrió en su academia. Jaime es menor de edad y su madre pide la anulación de su boda, porque él la engañó.
programme.sub-title: Abusada con síndrome de Down; Me lo cazó

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natalie pierde a su hija en la travesía a EE. UU., años más tarde descubre que está viva y fue adoptada. Dayana es transexual y le pide a Yohan una prueba de su hombría, luego cancela la boda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eva quiere una boda con su novio, pero su madre tiene planes de casarla con una mujer adinerada. Luis es muy macho y demanda a su amigo gay por divulgar que ellos tuvieron relaciones sexuales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anayansi desea recuperar la custodia de su hijo, pero la abuela se rehúsa. También, la hija de Cristian y Andrea tiene una enfermedad gastrointestinal que están tratando con excremento.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Abigaíl descubre que su hermana tiene una relación amorosa con el hombre que la violó. Samantha y Enrique son ruidosos en el sexo y esto ha afectado a su hijo adolescente, quien es invidente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Leticia abusa sexualmente del hijo de Cintia, ambos menores de 10 años, la niña está presa. Robinson somete a su nieta con autismo a un tratamiento que provoca daños cerebrales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jeanlin descubre que su "roommate" se prostituye y quiere desalojarla. José demanda a Elvis porque no le pagó el café que le sirvió en su reunión de negocios, y cuyo grano lo defeca un animal.
programme.sub-title: Atención medica y sexual urgente; Café de elefante

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Claribel quiere la custodia de su hermano con daño cerebral, porque su cuñada abusa de él por venganza. Carlos pierde un testículo por la picada de un guacamayo y responsabiliza a su esposa.
programme.sub-title: El maltratado; Paco y los calzoncillos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La esposa de Armando está secuestrada por la guerrilla colombiana. Los secuestradores piden hacer un intercambio: exigen que se entregue al hijo de ella con uno de los jefes de la guerrilla y la liberan. Además, Ángel está obsesionado con ser parte de las pruebas de medicamentos que hacen las farmacéuticas. Vive de eso y lo ha sufrido porque perdió su erección en uno de los estudios.
programme.sub-title: Una vida por otra; Conejillo de indias

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luz América intenta ir al funeral de su hija, pero su hermana y su madre lo impiden. Yarelis cuida a su hijo de 18 años como si fuera un bebé, el padre quiere que el chico se vaya de la casa.
programme.sub-title: Si te fuiste, a qué has vuelto; Mama's Boy

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El novio de Laura le cuidaba la mascota, el animal ingiere cocaína y aparece muerto. Andrés le practica sexo oral a su mujer durante la menstruación, le causa lesiones físicas y psicológicas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joan tiene la custodia total de su hija y Yuri descubre que la niña hace videos de "autobullying". En otro caso, la serpiente de Ángel y Rose se come al lindo perro de su vecina Katiana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Verónica siente que su hermana la estafó emocionalmente, incitándola a enamorarse de una amiga con quien tenía un acuerdo de sacarle todo el dinero posible. La hermana alega que nada fue premeditado. Benjamín odia a las iguanas y a los indocumentados. El estado de Florida permite dispararle a las iguanas con rifles de balines y él, alegando que le estaba disparando a una iguana, le pegó un tiro en un ojo a Iván, quién, casualmente, es indocumentado.
programme.sub-title: Duplo golpe emocional; Balines contra iguanas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liz y Joan tienen una hija albina, a quien le afecta vivir en Miami por su condición, la madre quiere irse del país. Bárbara exige que Rafael y Albert paguen por robarle sus clientes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anthony exige que su hermano Edgard le pague por haberlo violado. Una madre se niega a entregarle dinero a su hijo para sus estudios, ella alega que no escogió una carrera profesional.
programme.sub-title: Hermano abusa a hermano; Universidad de influencers

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Johnny sufre un accidente tras enterarse de que uno de sus hijos no es suyo. Simón y Dolores están en pleno acto sexual, cuando el esposo de ella los sorprende, le mutila el miembro al amante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una mujer quiere obtener la recompensa que ofrecen por su marido, un ladrón prófugo de la justicia. Por otro lado, Marina se entera de que un cura ha demostrado ser su padre. Por si fuera poco, este obtuvo su custodia y planea llevársela a Panamá.
programme.sub-title: La recompensa; Bendito sea mi padre

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere desalojarlos por conflictivos, ellos creen que los discrimina. Mirela llega a un acuerdo con José para quedarse con la pensión de su padre, pero el plan se cae cuando aparece la viuda.
programme.sub-title: Odio y desalojo; The Gold Digger

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tres hermanas se disputan la herencia de la madre, una dice que la división debe ser entre dos. La esposa de Santiago gana un buen sueldo, pero tienen que vivir en la ciudad más cara del país.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Está obsesionada y por celos ataca a la novia de su vecino, él la golpea y ahora ella quiere que la cuide. Yoli quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo porque su esposo come manatíes.
programme.sub-title: Un golpe bajo; Manatí al grill

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La niña muere por el agua alojada en sus pulmones, su madre culpa al papá. Marina queda muda cuando su hijastra le empuja la cara contra el pastel y se perfora las cuerdas vocales.
programme.sub-title: Ahogamiento tardío; La muda y el pastel

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cree que su esposa quiere que regrese solo por una herencia, ella pide que se haga un bypass gástrico. La madre exige custodia total de su hija, el papá es pastor de la iglesia de la marihuana.
programme.sub-title: Con todo el peso encima; Iglesia de la marihuana

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tras un accidente, mantienen intimidad como pueden, pero ella ya no aguanta más. Una congregación incita a sus fieles a tener sexo con la naturaleza y Celeste exige que le devuelvan el diezmo.
programme.sub-title: No se consumó; Fornicando la tierra

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrea hace churros con la receta de Isabel y le explotan en la cara, pide dinero para gastos médicos. Yuli atiende su heladería en 'body painting', exige que Brenda deje en paz a sus clientes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tres mujeres demandan a Jotsy por estafa, él se casó con ellas para luego abandonarlas. También, Ángela quiere que la reintegren en el coro, pero la directora no la acepta de regreso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela se defiende cuando la difaman, porque en su empresa hay una habitación para que los empleados tengan sexo. Lorenzo demanda a su madre, por su culpa no pudo ser pelotero profesional.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero move into a dream Victorian home, but eerie footsteps and slamming doors soon plague them. When Edwin sees a full-body apparition, they seek help. Lillian's behavior darkens as an evil female spirit possesses her. She suffers physical attacks in her sleep, and as the hauntings escalate, they realize escaping may no longer be an option.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After losing her husband in a tragic accident, Stacy Stowe hears ghostly sounds and assumes it's his spirit-until her daughter insists it's something evil. Dark figures prowl the home, and attacks escalate. A paranormal cleanser brings temporary peace, but a new psychic warns that unless Stacy closes the portal, the evil will never leave.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Joanne and Jim Whitley's dream of running a horse-riding business turns into a nightmare when strange occurrences plague their New Hampshire farm. Their son hears eerie sounds, and Joanne senses a dark presence. As financial struggles mount, their horses fall mysteriously ill. When the spirit turns violent and threatens their child, Joanne calls on a Shamballa master to fight the evil force.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Tiffany McKinnon, Billy Quattlebaum, and his daughter move into a 200-year-old farmhouse in Franklin, VA. While Tiffany tries to make peace with a lingering spirit, a darker entity lurks in the shadows, tormenting the family. Determined to stay, Tiffany seeks help from paranormal investigators and the church, hoping to expel the evil before it destroys their lives.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Tammy Shea, a single mother of three, relocates her family for a fresh start but her dream turns to a nightmare when her family is antagonized by multiple entities. Desperate, Tammy finds a paranormal team who reveal the true evil in the home.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Taiwan, many believe the spiritual and material worlds are intertwined. When an American family moves into a lavish mansion in the Yangmingshan Mountains, they witness disturbing supernatural events. Skeptical at first, they refuse to believe in ghosts-until their youngest daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest reveals the house was designed to empower the dead and torment the living.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Linda returns from India, her daughter Kara experiences terrifying events, convinced their home is haunted. Linda dismisses it-until she has her own chilling encounter. Realizing Kara was right, they turn to a clairvoyant for answers. As the truth of their haunting unravels, they must find a way to confront the unknown before it takes hold of their lives.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Shea family's Arkansas home seems peaceful until eerie voices and ghostly noises shatter the quiet. Believing it's the spirit of a young boy who died there, they feel at ease until a darker entity emerges, bringing terror. When one of their children suffers a serious injury, they fear the spirit is to blame. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to psychic mediums to confront the evil.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Angelina believes her home's ghost is harmless, but when her daughter starts hearing eerie voices, doubt creeps in. Medical tests reveal nothing, leading her parents to fear a supernatural cause. Desperate for answers, they seek help from a priest and a medium, who uncover a troubled spirit in need of peace-one that must be confronted before their daughter's fate is sealed.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Dream House When the VanLandingham family moves into an Arkansas home, their young daughters become the target of a supernatural attack by dark entities. After fruitless efforts by a Pastor and paranormal investigator, they decide to abandon their 'dream house' forever.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The historic Allen House in Arkansas is haunted. Mark and Rebecca Spencer knew it when they bought it. They investigate the cause of the haunting, discover the home's secret past and a previous owner who committed suicide.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: A Halloween dare leads high school friends Nick, Krystian, and Jon to an old cemetery in Green Lake, Wisconsin. Seeking a rumored haunted mausoleum, they become separated in the darkness. As they sense an eerie presence stalking them, their skepticism turns to terror. They must escape before the vengeful spirits of the graveyard awaken-and ensure they never leave.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: While recovering from surgery, Jacinda Rearick notices orbs in photos, believing them to be her late parents. But when her son sees a dark entity and shadowy tentacles attack her, she realizes something sinister has invaded their home. As the entity grows more violent, Jacinda turns to local investigators, desperate to rid her house of the encroaching evil.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Sherman family's dream life turns into a nightmare when 17-year-old Macy is targeted by a terrifying entity. As her mother and sister experience paranormal activity, their skeptical father remains unconvinced-until he hears an unseen presence speak. With the spirit refusing to leave, the desperate family turns to experts for help before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After moving to the suburbs, Bill and Amanda Toler dismiss eerie noises-until Bill is scratched and Amanda sees an inhuman face. Paranormal investigators uncover a portal in their home and a demon that followed Bill from his job at a penitentiary. In a race against time, they must close the portal and banish the entity before it destroys the family.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Darrin and Jamie Shriver move into a home where four people died of CO poisoning. Strange sounds and ghostly sightings soon turn sinister-Darrin and their dog are attacked. Paranormal investigators cleanse the home, but Darrin unknowingly invites dark forces back, putting his wife and newborn in grave danger. Can they escape the house's tragic fate?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Strange occurrences in Charles Gonzales' home awaken memories of past paranormal events tied to his uncle's unsolved murder. Seeking answers, he contacts psychic Desiree Page, who warns of a deadly family curse. When a vengeful spirit attacks Charles and his girlfriend, he must confront childhood memories and uncover hidden truths before the entity traps him forever.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: For years, a dark force stalks Lee Moore in his nightmares. After he and his bride Claire move into their first home, the entity emerges, attacking Claire while she's pregnant. A ghost hunter confirms it's a demon, and experts cleanse the home. But when the hunter returns for an uninvited ritual, Lee falls mysteriously ill. Can demonologists save him before the entity claims his soul?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Cindy's recurring nightmares of a dark, angry figure intensify as she moves her family to an old house in her rural hometown. Assuming it's just stress, she pushes forward, but soon, her dreams become reality. Her daughters fear their room, and an eerie presence lurks in the shadows. When the entity physically attacks her, Cindy must summon her courage to fight the evil before it harms her family.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Cranmer family believes their historic Pittsburgh home is haunted by a harmless ghost-until the activity turns violent. Seeking help from the Catholic Church, they uncover a demon and the home's dark past. As attacks escalate and walls ooze a blood-like substance, they refuse to flee, facing a terrifying battle that culminates in a desperate exorcism.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Morgan Knudson and her friend Bob move into a downtown Edmonton flat, only to discover a dark spirit lurking. While Bob, battling cancer and loneliness, sees a harmless ghostly boy, Morgan senses something sinister. When the entity violently attacks her, she seeks a demonologist who reveals the truth-the spirit is trying to possess Bob, and Morgan must act before it claims his soul.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Randy and Marcy, both in law enforcement, face mounting stress when their son is deployed overseas. Marcy's overwhelming fear awakens a dormant spirit that feeds on her anxiety, growing dangerously powerful. As the presence tightens its grip, Marcy must stay calm and find a way to banish the evil force before it drives her to the brink.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Devastated by a friend's murder, Julisa holds a séance to communicate one last time--and unwittingly invites a dark spirit into her home...and her life. Julisa and her mother believe that she has re-ignited the evil that plagued her mother years ago.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators risk their own safety to protect others. Mary Vogel, a spiritual counselor, faces a force that shakes her faith. Nightmares consume her, unseen entities attack, and even church feels sinister. A voice whispers, 'Your God can't help you now.' Her mentor, John Zaffis, realizes the truth-Mary is possessed, and only an exorcism can save her soul.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: A mother and daughter both believe their house is haunted. But while the mother believes it's the spirit of her murdered boyfriend, her daughter believes it's much darker. After paranormal experts investigate they uncover an epic battle between good and evil.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Lynn and Jason Ryder purchase a historic Connecticut restaurant, only to be overwhelmed by forces of evil when employees and patrons are attacked. Investigators, mediums and clairvoyants are called in to rid the restaurant of its demonic past.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After a chilling encounter at an Egyptian exhibit, Caleb Weaver is haunted by a relentless entity. Years of torment force him to flee, but when he returns home, the dark force reawakens-stronger than ever. Now, it seeks to possess him and threatens those he loves. With time running out, Caleb turns to a deliverance minister for a final battle against the ancient evil seeking his soul.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: After Jeanette's firefighter husband dies, she moves her daughters to a Long Island hamlet for a fresh start. But eerie discoveries and violent paranormal attacks turn their refuge into a nightmare. Determined to fight back, Jeanette enlists a psychic to uncover the home's dark past and a deliverance minister to confront the relentless evil threatening her family's safety.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Sandra Waldron is fascinated by the supernatural, but her son Gene wants no part of it. When they learn their home is haunted, Sandra dives deeper into the paranormal, eventually embracing Wicca. Seeking good fortune, she unknowingly opens a portal to evil. With Gene gone in the military, Sandra must now battle the dark force she unleashed before it consumes her entirely.
